## Summary

Financial claims and recommendations below are attributed to this September 25, 2026 report and its supplied September 24 technical snapshot. They are preserved historical claims, forecasts and conditions, not current market facts.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]

The report rates BULL Neutral/Wait with low-to-moderate confidence at IDR 380. A close at the session and 20-day low, negative trend/momentum groups, CMF −0.3631 and Volume Ratio 20D 0.3744 outweigh the oversold stochastic/short RSI and Fisher reversal. ATR Bullish and OBV/ADL increases are explicitly retained as conflicted early stabilization evidence, rather than reversal proof.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]

For the session-10 close, scenarios are bull IDR 404–426 at 25%, base IDR 380–402 at 40%, and bear IDR 356–378 at 35%. Representative gross expected return is approximately +2.26%, with weighted endpoints −0.63% to +5.16%. Its session-5 review on October 2 does not restart the October 9 horizon.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]

The report attributes strong first-half revenue/profit and fleet-related earnings upgrades to September releases. Favorable tanker freight is paired with vessel, insurance, route-access and operating risks. Fed tightening and BI/currency conditions are offsets. No scheduled company event is confirmed; speculative capital-action narratives remain unverified. Strong news was already public before the supplied bar, but the amount priced in is unknown.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]

Its preferred conditional entry is IDR 398–402 after a completed close above 398. Closing thesis invalidation is below 380; the executable stop is explicitly not estimable because ATR-stop anchoring is undefined. Profit zones are 404–415 and conditionally 426. The illustrative 400/380/415 structure gives only 0.75:1 gross reward-to-risk, supporting waiting rather than chasing.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]

The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, while emphasizing mixed USD revenue/cost and domestic-liquidity effects. It attributes a September 16 Fed increase to higher global rates, financing pressure and weaker emerging-market risk appetite; the company-specific net currency impact is unknown.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]
